'''Industrial Heuristics''' was a company that served the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ayanos Bactra]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]].

==History==
Industrial Heuristics was responsible for the development of [[arxeum]]s, giant mobile educational facilities that were dedicated to the study of war sciences. The company was also given permission to carry out recruitment operations within the [[Daimanate]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] territory controlled by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] Sith Lord [[Daiman]].

In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], Daiman made a deal with Bactra to acquire an arxeum of his own. In exchange for safe passage to strike at [[Vellas Pavo]], Bactra oversaw the delivery of the arxeum to [[Gazzari]]. After a [[Battle of Gazzari|battle]] there, Daiman and his brother [[Odion]] captured Bactra's holdings, on the orders of their grandmother, [[Vilia Calimondra]]. Calimondra bequeathed control of Industrial Heuristics to Daiman and forced Odion, who had [[Battle of Jutrand|captured]] [[Jutrand]], Bactra's former [[Capital/Legends|capital]], to allow the company to withdraw from the world.
